comparison_horizon: current TTM versus exact fiscal Q-1
numerator_or_change: maximum of absolute revenue change and absolute Operating Income change
denominator_or_scaling: each change divided by R; R is average absolute current/prior revenue
floor_or_validity: R has USD 10000000 floor; both revenues strictly positive
rendered_finnish_definition: Nykyinen TTM vs tarkka fiscal Q-1; suurempi arvoista |delta liikevaihto|/R ja |delta Operating Income|/R; R = max(keskimaarainen |liikevaihto|, 10 M$); >= 20 %, jompikumpi muutos

comparison_horizon: current TTM versus exact fiscal Q-1
numerator_or_change: absolute difference between Reported Common Earnings change and operating-cash-flow change
denominator_or_scaling: divided by the same revenue scale R as abrupt shift
floor_or_validity: R has USD 10000000 floor; both revenues strictly positive
rendered_finnish_definition: Nykyinen TTM vs tarkka fiscal Q-1; |delta Reported Common Earnings - delta operating cash flow|/R; R = max(keskimaarainen |liikevaihto|, 10 M$); >= 20 %

comparison_horizon: current TTM versus exact fiscal Q-1
numerator_or_change: absolute difference between current and prior absolute CAPEX intensities
denominator_or_scaling: each period uses absolute CAPEX divided by max(revenue; USD 10000000)
floor_or_validity: USD 10000000 denominator floor separately for both periods; both revenues strictly positive
rendered_finnish_definition: Nykyinen TTM vs tarkka fiscal Q-1; intensiteettien itseisarvoero, jossa intensiteetti = |CAPEX|/max(liikevaihto, 10 M$); >= 10 pp

comparison_horizon: current TTM versus exact fiscal Q-1
numerator_or_change: absolute change in total debt minus cash
denominator_or_scaling: divided by the same revenue scale R as abrupt shift
floor_or_validity: R has USD 10000000 floor; both revenues strictly positive
rendered_finnish_definition: Nykyinen TTM vs tarkka fiscal Q-1; |delta(kokonaisvelka - kassa)|/R; R = max(keskimaarainen |liikevaihto|, 10 M$); >= 50 %

comparison_horizon: current valuation endpoint without Q-1 comparison
numerator_or_change: median and maximum of available Operating Income/EV, FCF/Market Cap and Reported Common Earnings/Market Cap raw yields
denominator_or_scaling: each yield uses its named EV or Market Cap denominator
floor_or_validity: no separate floor; finite available yields required
rendered_finnish_definition: Nykyinen valuation-endpoint, ei Q-1-vertailua; saatavilla olevien raw-yieldien mediaani ja maksimi; mediaani >= 25 % TAI maksimi >= 50 %

comparison_horizon: current TTM versus exact fiscal Q-1
numerator_or_change: signed current Operating Margin minus prior Operating Margin
denominator_or_scaling: Operating Margin is Operating Income divided by revenue
floor_or_validity: both revenues strictly positive; Operating Income may be negative
threshold_and_operator: current Trajectory >= 7 AND signed margin change <= -2 percentage points
rendered_finnish_definition: Nykyinen TTM vs tarkka fiscal Q-1; suunnallinen Operating Margin -muutos ja nykyinen Trajectory; Trajectory >= 7 JA muutos <= -2 pp

comparison_horizon: current canonical period versus exact fiscal Q-1
numerator_or_change: absolute change in ONWC; ONWC = accounts receivable + inventory - accounts payable - deferred revenue
denominator_or_scaling: divided by max(average current/prior total assets; USD 10000000)
floor_or_validity: USD 10000000 denominator floor; both total-assets values strictly positive
rendered_finnish_definition: Nykyinen canonical-kausi vs tarkka fiscal Q-1; |delta ONWC|/max(keskimaarainen taseen loppusumma, 10 M$); ONWC = myyntisaamiset + varasto - ostovelat - saadut ennakot; >= 10 %
